caseNameFull: WELLENS v. DILLON, SECRETARY OF THE TREASURY, Et Al.
attorneys: Appellant pm se., Solicitor General Cox, Acting Assistant Attorney General Guilfoyle and Morton Hollander for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Goldberg took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
